title: Photographs: a visiting New Orleans trombonist and Foster's pneumonia
summary: Photos of a big-chief trombonist visiting New York and of Foster after his hospital stay with pneumonia.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Always wearing glasses. This is a little bit of sketchy. Now, this is when Papa Sutterstatt come up here to visit the player of the date up here, this big chief trombone player, this big Indian chief. Who was that? That was at the Metro Bowl. Oh, in New York. New York, see? Oh, I didn't remember. See, Papa Sutterstatt, see? And this is a good friend. He was staying at my house when he come up here. Uh-huh. See? And I went down to this big chief, big Indian trombone player.
Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. He was the last I heard him, uh...

I left him, Alma's brother's kid, and me. I got it all on the record date. Well, he was down in New Orleans, big chief, not long ago. This is me when I had a long come out of the hospital from pneumonia. Uh-huh.
What was the hospital that you are?
